interventions.detail: requirements.txt omits torch; installed CPU torch==2.2.2 from the PyTorch CPU index
pinned numpy<2 to work with torch 2.2 / transformers 4.37
used a uv-managed Python 3.10 venv instead of the system Python 3.12
Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat no longer downloads from Hugging Face (401); fetched the official ModelScope copy into ./Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat so the -c argument resolves locally
env.sh sets HF_HUB_OFFLINE/TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE and cd's to /work/Qwen so the local checkpoint path is used
